meta.title: LIAN Plastic Surgery | Natural Beauty, Thoughtfully Designed
meta.description: Personalized aesthetic care guided by your natural facial and body proportions, from consultation through treatment and recovery.

headline: Natural beauty,
thoughtfully designed
hero.description: We do not believe in changing who you are. We refine the proportions you already have, with one consistent standard from consultation through recovery.

image.alt: Close portrait of a woman resting among pink peonies in natural light

heading: Beyond trends,
we begin with balance
paragraphs: The same procedure does not suit everyone. We begin by reading the proportions of the face and body before discussing a surgical method.
Our standard is not what looks most fashionable today, but what can remain natural years from now. Consultation, treatment, recovery, and follow-up are one connected process.
principles: Personalized care that respects natural proportions
A shared decision between medical judgment and patient goals

image.alt: A calm, naturally lit space prepared for a consultation

heading: Not simply weight,
but the flow of your silhouette

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Basic questions to check before visiting. Clinic-specific arrangements will be published after verification.

items.question: Do I need an appointment?
items.answer: Booking methods and walk-in availability are not yet confirmed. Online bookings are currently unavailable.

items.question: Is there a fee for a consultation?
items.answer: Consultation and examination fees are not yet confirmed. Free consultations are not guaranteed.

items.question: What should I bring to a consultation?
items.answer: Required documents and preparation information will be published with confirmed booking guidance.

items.question: What kind of anaesthesia is used?
items.answer: Procedure-specific anaesthesia arrangements and staffing will be published after verification.

items.question: Can I consult about surgery performed at another clinic?
items.answer: Consultations following surgery elsewhere and any required records need confirmation from the clinic.

items.question: Does someone need to accompany me on the day?
items.answer: Ask the treating team whether an accompanying adult is required for your individual plan.

items.question: How long until I can return to my routine?
items.answer: Return-to-routine timing depends on the procedure and individual circumstances and needs confirmation from the treating team.

items.question: When do I come back after surgery?
items.answer: Follow-up scheduling will be published once actual care arrangements are confirmed.

items.question: How are swelling and bruising managed?
items.answer: Follow individual instructions from your treating team. This page does not provide treatment instructions.

items.question: How is the cost determined?
items.answer: Check the cost breakdown and inclusions against your actual care plan and the clinic's confirmed information.

items.question: Can I get a price without a consultation?
items.answer: Telephone or messenger estimates are not yet confirmed as an available service.

items.question: Are there additional costs after surgery?
items.answer: Whether aftercare or additional examinations are included is not yet confirmed.

faq.notice: These answers describe general clinical practice and do not replace a diagnosis or prescription. Outcomes vary from person to person, so please consult a specialist directly.

categories.name: Eye Surgery
categories.description: We consider eye direction, lid thickness, and the distance between brow and eye before defining a crease.

categories.name: Rhinoplasty
categories.description: We prioritize proportion over height so the nose feels balanced from both front and profile views.

categories.name: Facial Contour
categories.description: Planning considers soft tissue and overall facial length in addition to bone structure.

categories.name: Lifting
categories.description: We identify whether laxity comes from skin, volume, or deeper tissue before choosing an approach.

categories.name: Skin & Injectables
categories.description: Downtime and your return to daily life guide the intensity and sequence of care.

categories.name: Body
categories.description: The goal is not weight loss, but a more balanced flow through each contour.
